title: Blessed Are the Forgiven

questions.question: Blessed is the one whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:1 (ESV): "Blessed is the one whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered."

questions.question: Blessed is the man against whom the Lord counts no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:2 (ESV): "Blessed is the man against whom the Lord counts no iniquity,"

questions.question: And in whose spirit there is no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:2 (ESV): "...and in whose spirit there is no deceit."

questions.question: For when I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:3 (ESV): "For when I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long."

questions.question: I acknowledged my sin to you, and I did not cover my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:5 (ESV): "I acknowledged my sin to you, and I did not cover my iniquity;"

questions.question: I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the Lord," and you did what?
options: Forgave the iniquity of my sin
questions.correctAnswer: Forgave the iniquity of my sin
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:5 (ESV): "...and you forgave the iniquity of my sin."

questions.question: Therefore let everyone who is godly offer prayer to you at a time when you may be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:6 (ESV): "Therefore let everyone who is godly offer prayer to you at a time when you may be found;"

questions.question: You are a hiding place for me; you preserve me from what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:7 (ESV): "You are a hiding place for me; you preserve me from trouble;"

questions.question: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my what upon you?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:8 (ESV): "...I will counsel you with my eye upon you."

questions.question: Be not like a horse or a mule, without what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:9 (ESV): "Be not like a horse or a mule, without understanding,"

questions.question: Which must be curbed with bit and bridle, or it will not stay near whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:9 (ESV): "...or it will not stay near you."

questions.question: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but steadfast love surrounds the one who trusts in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:10 (ESV): "...but steadfast love surrounds the one who trusts in the Lord."

questions.question: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, O righteous, and shout for joy, all you who are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:11 (ESV): "...shout for joy, all you upright in heart!"

questions.question: What type of Psalm is Psalm 32 identified as in the title?
For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was dried up as by the heat of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 32:4 (ESV): "...my strength was dried up as by the heat of summer."

key_verse_text: Blessed is the one whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered. Blessed is the man against whom the Lord counts no iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
